## Problem and result

What was difficult or broken, and what can a user do after this change?
Link the related issue when there is one.

## Validation

Describe the checks run and their results, including skips or platform limits.
For terminal UI changes, include a redacted screenshot and the interactions inspected.
For performance claims, link the comparison and its evidence.

## Review notes

Include relevant tradeoffs, compatibility changes or remaining work. Remove this
section if there is nothing else a reviewer needs.
